items.title: Ken Peplowski interviewed by Monk Rowe, Aspen, Colorado, October 10, 1997 [interview 1 of 2]
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] You could do a double bill with “Annie.” >> [INTERVIEWEE] Yes. Annie the Tragedy. The Lost Years. Annie on 42nd Street.

ctx.x: You could do a double bill with “Annie.”
Yes. Annie the Tragedy. The Lost Years. Annie on 42nd Street. No but hey look, you have to have a sense of humor to do this you know. But what was your question anyway?
I don’t know if there was a question. I just got a kick out of reading that.
